developers.docsAuthBody: Send the key on every request:
developers.docsMoneyNote: Money amounts are always integer minor units (piasters) on the wire — never a decimal.
developers.docsRateLimitNote: Keys are rate-limited per key, same as a human session.

einvoice.apiUrlDesc: ETA's document service. Must start with https://.
einvoice.clientSecretDesc: Stored encrypted; never shown again. Leave blank to keep the current one.

insight.allInStock: All items are in stock. This order can be fulfilled now.

warn.oneShort: One item is short on stock.
warn.creditHigh: Customer credit used: {{pct}}% — near the limit.
warn.creditExceeded: Customer has exceeded the credit limit ({{pct}}%).

delivered.title: Couldn't deliver {{number}}
delivered.reason: There isn't enough stock to deliver every item. Receive the short items, then try again.

received.title: Purchase order {{number}} received
received.context: Goods received. Record the bill to owe the supplier.

paid.title: Purchase order {{number}} paid
paid.context: Paid in full. Nothing more to do.

returned.title: Purchase order {{number}} returned
returned.context: Return recorded. A debit note was issued.

converted.title: Purchase order {{number}} created
converted.context: Created from a request. It's ready to confirm.

created.title: Purchase request {{number}} created
created.context: It's ready to submit for approval.

approved.title: Purchase request {{number}} approved
approved.context: Approved. Convert it to a purchase order.

created.title: Supplier {{name}} added
created.context: You can now order from and pay this supplier.

receipt.title: Stock received ({{ref}})
receipt.context: Received into stock. The journal entry is posted.

issue.title: Stock issued ({{ref}})
issue.context: Issued from stock. The journal entry is posted.
